app_store.name: Kinet
app_store.subtitle: Fitness RPG: macros + AI
app_store.promotional_text: Free forever. Macro tracking + AI coaching. No subscription, no invite loops.
app_store.description:
Kinet is the free, offline-first fitness RPG that tracks your workouts, nutrition, and progress — all without a subscription.

WHAT YOU GET
• Complete workout tracker — 60+ exercises with GIFs/videos, custom exercises, superset support
• Built-in nutrition — calorie & macro tracking, meal logging, AI insights connecting food to performance
• Smart progress charts — weekly volume, personal records, muscle distribution, streak tracking
• AI post-workout analysis — volume trends, fatigue signals, protein adequacy, next-week suggestions
• Safety first — pause/stop/resume any workout, no progress lost to injury or sickness
• Offline-first — all features work offline, sync when online (optional cloud sync)
• Free forever — no subscription, no invite loops, no feature gates

THE PROBLEM WE SOLVED
Most fitness apps gate core features behind subscriptions. The leading app forces you to pay or invite 3 friends before your first workout. Kinet gives you everything free — because your progress shouldn't be behind a paywall.

NUTRITION MEETS RPG
Most fitness trackers ignore nutrition. Kinet logs calories, macros, meals — then AI connects your protein intake to your PRs. Your nutrition finally fuels your RPG progression.

SAFETY FIRST
Injured? Sick? Tap Pause. Resume tomorrow or discard. No progress lost. Your body, your rules.

OFFLINE-FIRST
All features work without internet. Your data stays on your device. Optional manual backup keeps devices in sync.

FREE FOREVER
No subscription. No invite loops. No feature gates. 

PRIVACY FIRST
Your data, your device. Export anytime as CSV/JSON. Delete account anytime — wiped in 24 hours. No tracking, no ads.

JOIN THOUSANDS OF LIFTERS
Kinet: Free fitness RPG with macro tracking, AI coaching, and offline workouts. Download free today.
